summary: The board item's load-bearing 'verified, not assumed' fact had decayed between filing and claim: it stated all seven Total* counters had zero reads outside PerformanceEvidence.fs and EvidenceCommands.fs, but on the claimed tree EvidenceCommands.fs reads none of them and four test files read four of them.

summary: No SDD lifecycle stage was authored for this cycle: the item is a hardening reshape with no new requirement, and the acceptance criteria live in the board item rather than a work/<id>/spec.md. The eight existing work/ directories were read as historical context only.

A board-item-#20 reflection guard asserted the names Enemies/Obstacles/ShopSlots were ABSENT from Model; retiring the M5 prefix made those the SURVIVING names, so the guard's two loops became textually identical and it failed on a change that broke nothing. A guard phrased as name-absence cannot survive a later rename that reuses the name.
cost: one failing test run plus one guard rewrite; the guard was restated to assert by TYPE (exactly one Model field carries EnemyActor list, Obstacle list, ShopSlot list) which no rename can satisfy vacuously

summary: A word-boundary regex rename across .fs sources silently rewrites field names inside STRING LITERALS as well as in code, and the F# compiler cannot see the difference. Three literals inside a reflection guard were rewritten, which is what made that guard self-contradictory rather than merely stale.
cost: one scripted audit of every changed quoted string in the diff (21 distinct literals, 3 load-bearing) to separate deliberate prose updates from silent guard damage
owner: EHotwagner/rogue3 worker practice for identifier renames

summary: PerformanceEvidence cannot distinguish a rename from a dropped counter: the m7-ui route check runs first and returns early on its exit code, and those route digests hash Model.fs BYTES - so any edit to Model.fs reds the target before a single cost driver is evaluated. The cost-driver check, which is the only thing that catches a dropped counter, is reachable only AFTER the digest has been refreshed.
cost: none this cycle - the cost drivers were read deliberately - but the ordering means a worker who re-derives the digest and stops at green would ship a dropped counter with the gate reporting success
